stories.title: Minister ontbiedt Israëlische ambassadeur na wegsturen diplomaten Westoever

en.title: Minister summons Israeli ambassador after expulsion of diplomats from West Bank
en.summary: The Dutch Foreign Minister called in the Israeli ambassador following Israel's decision to revoke the diplomatic status of Dutch officials stationed in Ramallah on the occupied West Bank.

stories.title: Celstraf voor Turkse komiek die Erdogan 'verlegen dictator' noemde

en.title: Prison sentence for Turkish comedian who called Erdogan 'shy dictator'
en.summary: A Turkish stand-up comedian was sentenced to 19 months in prison for insulting President Erdogan and religious values in a performance. The comedian's show, posted online, garnered millions of views.

stories.title: Berendsen ontbiedt Israëlische ambassadeur vanwege uitzetten diplomaten

en.title: Berendsen summons Israeli ambassador regarding expulsion of diplomats
en.summary: The Dutch Foreign Minister summoned the Israeli ambassador to explain Israel's decision to revoke diplomatic status of Dutch mission staff in Ramallah, with the officials required to leave within seven days.

stories.title: Nederland ontbiedt Israëlische ambassadeur vanwege wegsturen diplomaten van Westelijke Jordaanoever

en.title: Netherlands summons Israeli ambassador over expulsion of diplomats from West Bank
en.summary: The Netherlands summoned the Israeli ambassador in response to Israel's decision to expel Dutch diplomats from the occupied West Bank.

stories.title: Anderhalf jaar cel voor populaire Turkse komiek na beledigen Erdogan: ‘Een eer dat mijn woorden zoveel impact hebben’

en.title: 18 months imprisonment for popular Turkish comedian after insulting Erdogan: 'An honor that my words have such impact'
en.summary: A popular Turkish comedian has been sentenced to 18 months in prison for insulting President Erdogan during a performance.

stories.title: Meer dan honderd doden bij overstromingen in grensgebied Nepal en India

en.title: More than one hundred deaths in flooding in Nepal-India border region
en.summary: Over 100 people have died in flooding affecting the Nepal-India border area, following weeks of heavy rainfall in a region previously devastated by floods that killed 1,400 people.

stories.title: Verdachten van mogelijk verijdelde terreuraanval op Britse luchtmachtbasis op borgtocht vrijgelaten

en.title: Suspects in suspected foiled terror attack on British air force base released on bail
en.summary: Individuals suspected of planning a terror attack on a British air force base have been released on bail pending further proceedings.

stories.title: Turkse komiek krijgt negentien maanden cel voor beledigen Erdogan

en.title: Turkish comedian receives 19 months prison for insulting Erdogan
en.summary: Turkish comedian Deniz Göktas has been sentenced to 19 months in prison for insulting President Erdogan during a performance and for insulting religious values.

stories.title: Noodweer in India en Nepal, dodental loopt op tot boven de honderd

en.title: Severe weather in India and Nepal, death toll rises above one hundred
en.summary: Heavy storms have caused over 100 deaths in the border region of India and Nepal, with severe flooding and landslides destroying thousands of homes and injuring many others.

stories.title: Ombudsman in brandbrief: Sinti, Roma en reizigers nog altijd gediscrimineerd

en.title: Ombudsman in urgent letter: Sinti, Roma and travellers still discriminated against
en.summary: The national ombudsman reports that Sinti, Roma and traveller communities in the Netherlands continue to face discrimination in employment, insurance and housing nine years after initial findings.

stories.title: Ombudsman uit forse kritiek op de overheid vanwege uitblijven woonwagenplekken Sinti en Roma

en.title: Ombudsman issues strong criticism of government over lack of caravan sites for Sinti and Roma
en.summary: The ombudsman has criticized the government for failing to provide adequate caravan sites for Sinti and Roma communities.

stories.title: Meer dan honderd doden in Nepal en India door overstromingen na noodweer

en.title: More than one hundred deaths in Nepal and India due to flooding after severe weather
en.summary: Over 100 people have died in Nepal and India following severe storms that caused extensive flooding and landslides in recent days.
